title: [Issue]: cannot import name 'OpenAIWrapper' from 'autogen
body:
### Describe the issue

I can not locate the OpenAiWrapper in Autogen.

I am currently experiencing an issue with the autogen package (version 1.0.16). Despite successful installation, I am unable to locate the OpenAIWrapper class within the package structure. My attempts to find it in the GitHub repository also returned no results. I believe this class is critical for my project's integration with the OpenAI API.

Could you please provide guidance on where I can find OpenAIWrapper, or confirm if it is included in the current version of the package? If it has been moved or renamed, could you please direct me to the correct module or provide the updated usage
